newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA M1 UP 0.1 PCT, M2 FALLS 2.6 PCT IN WEEK.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA M1 UP 0.1 PCT, M2 FALLS 2.6 PCT IN WEEK.

text.p: Bulgarian M1 money supply inched up to 148.4 billion levs on October 4 from 147.9 billion levs on September 27 and M2 fell to 788.8 billion levs from 809.9 billion levs, preliminary central bank figures showed.

Total broad money decreased by 3.34 percent to 820.8 billion levs as lev-denominated broad money inched up 1.62 percent to 487.9 billion levs and dollar-denominated broad money fell 8.24 percent to 332.9 billion levs.
Hard currency-denominated term deposits of companies and individuals totalled $ 1.385 billion on October 4, down $72 million from September 27.
Lev-denominated term deposits of companies and individuals rose to 282.1 billion levs on October 4 from 273.2 billion levs on September 27. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
